questionEditorForm.contentPlaceholder: Enter the essay prompt, fill-in-the-blank question, or reading passage in detail...
questionEditorForm.choicesSectionTitle: Set up {{count}} answers & mark 1 correct answer
questionEditorForm.choicesHint: Click the check button to mark the correct answer
questionEditorForm.inlineChoiceHint: Write the full sentence in "Question content" above, mark the position to choose with ___ (e.g. "We/Us saw ___ yesterday." → write "___ saw him yesterday."), then enter the 2 options below.
questionEditorForm.picChoiceHint: Each answer is a picture — students listen to the audio then tap the matching picture. The caption/alt-text below each image is optional.
questionEditorForm.listeningAudioSubmissionHint: Students will listen to this audio file and record their own answer to submit (graded manually in "Grading Queue") — different from Voice multiple choice (students only pick from the given options).
questionEditorForm.listeningFillInBlankHint: Students will listen to this audio file and type their answer — the system auto-grades based on the "Correct answer" below.
questionEditorForm.voicePictureChoiceHint: Students will listen to this audio file then pick one of the pictures above.
questionEditorForm.optionalAudioLabel: Attach listening audio (optional) — adding audio automatically tags this question with the Listening skill
questionEditorForm.wordBankSectionTitle: Word bank — correct answers in blank order
questionEditorForm.wordBankHint: Write the passage with blanks in "Question content" above, mark each blank with ___ in the EXACT order of the words below — students choose via dropdown, each word used exactly once.
questionEditorForm.wordBankMultiSentenceWarning: ⚠ If this exercise has MULTIPLE separate sentences (e.g. 10-12 numbered items), this type bundles them all into a single question and grades all-or-nothing (1 wrong blank loses all the points for the whole thing). To give each sentence its own "Question N." label and its own points, use the "Multiple fill-in-the-blank questions" tab in the compose-mode step instead.
questionEditorForm.sentenceBuildingSectionTitle: Word/phrase chunks — in the EXACT order of the complete sentence
questionEditorForm.sentenceBuildingHint: Enter the word/phrase chunks in the EXACT order that forms the complete sentence — students will see these chunks shuffled and must reorder them for the system to auto-grade (exact order match).
questionEditorForm.wordBankPictureHint: For the "Look at the pictures and write the correct words from the box" format — 1 picture with numbered spots + a shared word bank, each blank picks exactly 1 word from the bank.
questionEditorForm.wordBankOptionsHint: Word bank shown to students (optional) — leave empty to use the correct answers above as the bank. Fill this in to add distractor words (e.g. a 7-word bank but only 5 blanks used).
questionEditorForm.letterScrambleHint: For the "Rearrange the letters to make correct words" format — each chunk below is a single LETTER (not a word), in the EXACT order that forms the correct word — students will see the letters shuffled and must reorder them.
questionEditorForm.correctAnswerHint: Matching is case-insensitive, leading/trailing whitespace is trimmed automatically when grading — only 1 accepted answer.
questionEditorForm.essayImagePlaceholder: Choose an image or PDF file...
questionEditorForm.speakingKeywordsLabel: Key phonemes / vocabulary the student must pronounce accurately *
questionEditorForm.explanationPlaceholder: Enter the detailed explanation (for multiple choice) or the detailed grading rubric (for essay/speaking)...
